name: Notify when a task finishes
description: Sends a push notification through ntfy when a coding task finishes.

config.title: ={{ (trigger.task.state = "succeeded" ? "Done: " : (trigger.task.state = "failed" ? "Failed: " : "Stopped: ")) & trigger.task.title }}
config.message: ={{ (trigger.task.error ? trigger.task.error : (trigger.task.summary ? trigger.task.summary : "No summary.")) & (trigger.task.repoName ? "\n\n" & trigger.task.repoName & " on " & trigger.task.runnerName : "") }}
